title: lithocarpus collettii
intro: Lithocarpus collettii, commonly known as the Collett's Lithocarpus or Taiwanese Lithocarpus, is a species of tree in the beech family Fagaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine in Taiwan. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus collettii are attributed to its flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
